## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D phone/tablet browser game from the Spanish request: wide clean rocky arena, animated lava with orange glow that does not damage the player, a robot player with bazooka + sword, an identical rival robot, and sword parry that reflects incoming rockets in the opposite direction when the player is looking at the projectile.

## Requirements
- 3D game, phone/tablet first (responsive + touch controls), desktop also playable.
- Wide, clean rocky map with animated lava between rocks and orange glow; glow/lava must not damage player.
- Player robot carries bazooka and sword; second robot has the same capabilities.
- Bazooka projectile can be parried with sword; reflects back toward where it came from if player parries while looking at the projectile.
- Build complete playable game, no clarifying questions; note assumptions briefly at finish.
- Screenshot checks: small JPEGs, viewport ≤1280px wide; read only latest image.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a static `index.html` + native ES modules; Three.js 0.160 vendored locally (no build step, works with default HTML server).
- Added UnrealBloom post-processing, procedural terrain/rocks/lava shader, embers, lava bubbles, and synthetic WebAudio SFX.
- Player is third-person over-shoulder; camera yaw/vertical aim controls; auto-aim assist to rival's chest within ~20°.
- Enemy also parries every second player rocket (counter toggled), keeping “same capabilities”; enemy cannot parry already-reflected rockets, so the loop ends in damage.
- Lava is fully non-damaging (safe to cross); noted in menu footer.
- Match: player HP 110, enemy HP 120; player rocket 22 dmg, sword 15, reflected rocket 34; enemy rocket 14, enemy reflection 20; win/lose + restart/menu.
- UI in Spanish, original title “DUELO DE MAGMA”, local Orbitron/Rajdhani fonts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full game code, menu, countdown, HUD, touch joystick, fire/sword buttons, keyboard/mouse support, pause-free loop, win/lose/restart/menu flows.
- Procedural arena with rocky floor, perimeter cliffs, boulders, gravel, lava pools + shader animation, bubbles, glow, point lights, embers.
- Robot models with armor, visor, shoulder bazooka, glowing sword, thrusters, walk/swing/recoil/death animation, hit flash.
- Player/enemy combat, rockets, collision, explosions, parry/reflection, enemy AI and enemy parry, stats, audio.
- Verified in browser (no console errors after fixes):
  - Player rocket hit enemy: 22 damage.
  - Enemy rocket hit player: 14 damage.
  - Player parry reflected enemy rocket (`owner: "player"`, `parries: 1`, parry stat incremented).
  - Enemy parry reflected player rocket (`owner: "enemy"`, player took 20).
- Screenshots generated and inspected: `menu3.jpg`, `play7.jpg`, `parry_incoming.jpg`, `parry_reflect2.jpg`, `mobile_menu.jpg`, `mobile_play.jpg`, `end_win.jpg`.
- End screen renders correctly with VICTORIA / stats / REVANCHA / VOLVER AL MENÚ.

### Active
- Final visual/UX polish and final verification pass; gameplay tuning still possible.
- Current end-screen screenshot confirms victory overlay but end background is blurred/dark; acceptable.
- Need check mobile portrait camera distance/player size and possibly clipping of joystick label.
- Need final menu screenshot after latest changes (ambient light, mesas, marker) and maybe mobile end screen.

### Blocked
- (none)
